project_type: Academic document repository with LaTeX articles, presentations, and research documents
language: LaTeX (primary for this task), Python (for auxiliary scripts)
build_system: LaTeX compilation via pdflatex + bibtex (or latexmk)
test_framework: No automated tests - validation is PDF compilation success
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/sonet-product/artikel_review_2 && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex && bibtex main && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex
test_command: pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex (check exit code 0 and PDF generation)
verification_instructions: 1. Install texlive packages if not present. 2. Run pdflatex + bibtex compilation. 3. Verify PDF is generated. 4. Check page count is >= 30.
snapshot_or_generated_files: main.pdf is the generated output from main.tex + references.bib
setup_instructions: dnf install -y texlive-scheme-full or at minimum: texlive-latex texlive-elsarticle texlive-bibtex texlive-collection-fontsrecommended texlive-collection-latexrecommended texlive-collection-latexextra
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - can install any packages. LaTeX (texlive) not pre-installed - must install via dnf. Python 3.11 available.
contribution_requirements: Create folder artikel_review_2/ at repo root. Include main.tex, references.bib, and compiled main.pdf.
key_patterns: Existing artikel_review/ uses elsarticle document class with [review,authoryear] options, geometry a4paper margin=2.5cm, linenumbers enabled, tikz figures, longtable, booktabs. References in separate .bib file. Journal set to Earth-Science Reviews.
relevant_files: artikel_review/main.tex (pattern reference for document structure and formatting)
directory_structure: Repository root contains multiple project folders: artikel_review/ (existing GNN-EEW article), doc_spec_fsm_superapp/, fsm-superapp/, hilirisasi_fsm/, research-map/, etc. New folder artikel_review_2/ to be created at root level.
